correctness.rationale: The fixed path P on d+1 vertices has exactly (d+1)n^(n-d-2) containing trees. Delete r designated off-path leaves and s prescribed endpoint leaves, leaving a compulsory path with d+1-s vertices and n-r-s surviving labels. Its rooted-forest extension count times (n-r-s)^r yields (d+1-s)(n-r-s)^(n-d-2); divide and sum factorial moments. The exceptional adjacent-two-endpoints case must be zero. The covariance is negative for n-d-2>0 because 1-2/n<(1-1/n)^2. At d=n-2 exponent zero and at d=n-1 X is identically zero. The spanning-path negative exponent is interpreted by the exact integer counting formula, not a free formal 0^(-1).
